name: Trade Market 2 Code
definition: Specifies a code for a trade market.

DMST.name: Domestic
DMST.definition: Transaction has an origin and a destination in the same country and is made in the currency of that country.

FRGN.name: Foreign
FRGN.definition: Transaction has an origin in one country and a destination in another and is made in the currency of either the origin or destination country.
